thePhysicalName: with C|j> = |-j>, C X C^dag = X^-1 and C Z C^dag = Z^-1, so C (x) I acts on Pauli labels as diag(-1,-1,1,1), computed by conjugating all 80 Pauli matrices: the reflection in the first factor's hyperbolic line. I (x) C gives diag(1,1,-1,-1) and C (x) C gives -I.
andItIsAllNinety: the conjugacy class of diag(-1,-1,1,1) in Sp(4,3) has 90 = 51840/576 elements, all involutions with a hyperbolic (-1)-eigenspace, 90 distinct eigenspaces: exactly the anomaly set. So the 90 cost anomalies are C on one factor of one of the 45 factorisations, and the centre -I is C (x) C.
